sections.title: 一、阅读理解 (Passage A)
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:

questions.prompt: 1. If you and your parents want to have two small bowls of mutton dumplings and three cups of juice in House of Dumplings, you should pay ________.
questions.translation: 如果你和你的父母想在“饺子馆”吃两小碗羊肉饺子和三杯果汁，你们应该付多少钱？
questions.explanation: 两小碗羊肉饺子为 15 × 2 = 30 元，三杯果汁为 7 × 3 = 21 元，共计 30 + 21 = 51 元。故选 C。

questions.prompt: 2. If you want to eat noodles on Friday, you have to go to the Hot Noodles ________.
questions.translation: 如果你想在星期五吃面条，你必须在什么时候去“热面馆”？
questions.explanation: 根据文中 Hot Noodles 的周五营业时间为“8:30 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. from Monday to Friday”，9:00 a.m. 属于该营业时间段内。故选 B。

questions.prompt: 3. Which of the following is TRUE?
options: Big Pizza is open every day.
There are five kinds of noodles in Hot Noodles.
House of Dumplings is open for 9 hours a day.
People can order food from the three restaurants online.
questions.translation: 下列哪一项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据 Big Pizza 的营业时间“9:30 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. from Monday to Sunday”可知，它每天都营业。故选 A。

questions.prompt: 4. We can probably read the passage in a(an) ________ magazine.
questions.translation: 我们很可能会在哪类杂志中读到这篇文章？
questions.explanation: 第一段首句即指出“If you travel to my city, you can have a try there”，介绍的是当地特色美食餐馆，适于刊登在旅游类杂志上。故选 B。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 (Passage B)
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
"Dad, are you happy today?" My daughter Wendy asked me when I took her home from school on March 20.

"Why are you asking this?" I asked.

"Today is the International (国际的) Day of Happiness," she said. "It's a day to be happy!"

"So did you have a happy day at school?"

"Of course! I played volleyball with my friend and I enjoyed it so much."

"Good," I said. "If you're happy, then I am, too." Talking about happiness with my daughter made me think more about happiness.

How can I get happiness? Maybe I should feel happy when my wife (妻子) says my cooking is very good. I know she's very kind, because I'm not a really good cook. Maybe I should be happy when my best friend says I play basketball well, but I know he says that just to make me happy. I know I'm not good at basketball. The more I think this way, the less happy I feel. My daughter doesn't think so much about happiness, so she's happy on most days. Maybe I can learn something from her about how to be happy. I should just enjoy the moment and think less about it, so should everyone.

questions.prompt: 5. Wendy asked her father "Are you happy?" on that day because ________.
options: she was happy on that day
she went home early on that day
it was the International Day of Happiness
questions.translation: 温迪那天问爸爸“你开心吗？”是因为什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段温迪回答“Today is the International Day of Happiness... It's a day to be happy!”可知，因为当天是国际幸福日。故选 D。

questions.prompt: 6. What made Wendy happy on that day?
questions.translation: 那天是什么让温迪感到开心？
questions.explanation: 根据温迪的回答“I played volleyball with my friend and I enjoyed it so much”可知，和朋友打排球让她很开心。故选 B。

questions.prompt: 7. Why does the father think Wendy is happy on most days?
options: Because she has a warm family.
Because she really lives a life without any worries.
Because she doesn't think so much about happiness.
questions.translation: 父亲为什么认为温迪大多数日子里都很开心？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“My daughter doesn't think so much about happiness, so she's happy on most days.”可知，因为她对幸福没有想得太多、瞻前顾后。故选 D。

questions.prompt: 8. What's the best title for the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章围绕父亲思考“How can I get happiness?”展开，最后得出要活在当下、少思虑的感悟。故最佳标题为 'How to Get Happiness'。选 A。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 (Passage C)
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
The weather is getting hot. Would you like to have some cucumber with mashed garlic (蒜泥黄瓜)? When you enjoy this tasty summer dish, don't forget to say "thanks" to one person - Zhang Qian.

Zhang Qian lived in the Han Dynasty. He was an early visitor (游客) on the Silk Road and brought many new foods and other things to China. The Silk Road was a long road. It was from China to Central Asia (中亚), and even Europe. Where is this dish from? The cucumber came from South Asia. In early times, Chinese people called it "hugua". "Hu" means "foreign (外国的)". That is to say it isn't from China. Later, its name changed to "huanggua".

What about garlic? Its home was in Central Asia. Zhang Qian brought it to China about 2,000 years ago. Garlic can make many dishes taste better. It is good for our health.

What is the Silk Road? The Silk Road was also called "Sweet Road". Besides (除……………之外) vegetables, it brought many kinds of tasty fruits to China, too. Do you like grapes? They also came from Central Asia.

Do you ever see the words "hu", "yang", "fan" or "xi" in Chinese names of some foods? These names usually mean that these foods do not come from China, such as "huluobo (carrots)" and "yangcong (onions)". Can you find more food that came through the Silk Road?

questions.prompt: 9. The Silk Road was also called "Sweet Road" because ________.
options: people got a lot of candies on the road.
people on the road were sweet and friendly.
many tasty fruits came to China through the road.
the food along the road was sweet.
questions.translation: 丝绸之路也被称为“甜蜜之路”是因为什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第4段“The Silk Road was also called 'Sweet Road'. Besides vegetables, it brought many kinds of tasty fruits to China, too.”可知是因为许多美味水果通过丝绸之路传入中国。故选 C。

questions.prompt: 10. Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: Zhang Qian brought the cucumber back from Central Asia.
Zhang Qian brought the grapes back from South Asia.
Garlic came from Central Asia about 2,000 years ago.
The Silk Road was from China to Europe and Africa.
questions.translation: 根据短文，下列哪一项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段“What about garlic? Its home was in Central Asia. Zhang Qian brought it to China about 2,000 years ago.”可知 C 项完全正确。黄瓜来自南亚而非中亚；葡萄来自中亚而非南亚；文中提到中亚和欧洲未提非洲。故选 C。

questions.prompt:
11. Which of the following didn't come from China according to the last paragraph?
① tomatoes
② bananas
③ watermelons
④ pears
questions.translation: 根据最后一段，下列哪些物品不是原产于中国？
questions.explanation: 最后一段指出中文名称带有“hu、yang、fan、xi”字样的食物通常不是产自中国。tomatoes（番茄/西红柿）含“fan/xi”，watermelons（西瓜）含“xi”，均符合此特征；而 bananas（香蕉）和 pears（梨）不含这些字样。因此 ①③ 属于非原产中国的食物。故选 B。

questions.prompt: 12. What might be the best title for the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题可能是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述了通过丝绸之路传入中国的各种蔬菜水果（如黄瓜、大蒜、葡萄、胡萝卜、洋葱等）。故最佳标题为 'Foods through the Silk Road'。选 D。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 (Passage D)
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
① Many people like to do good things. Kevin had a special plan-doing 143 good things. Why 143? The number 143 has a special meaning to Kevin. It is another way to say "I love you." Each number stands for the number of letters in each word. The number "1" stands for "I", "4" stands for "love" and "3" stands for "you".

② Months ago, Kevin did his first good thing in the plan. He cleaned up an open space in the city. "It had a lot of tall grass. Cars ran on it over and over again," said Kevin. "Then I cut the grass down." He also handed out free food to people along the way.

③ One day, Kevin visited sick kids in Children's Hospital. He ended the day by helping an old man in the rain. He drove the man home.

④ Kevin said, "The whole idea is to do 143 good things. But it is really spreading (传播) love and kindness around." He added, "I want to encourage more people to join me. I hope that there will be a ripple effect (涟漪效应)." Let's start some ripples and see how far they can go!

questions.prompt: 13. Kevin wants to do 143 good things because ________.
options: the number is lucky for him
the number is special for him
questions.translation: 凯文想做 143 件好事，是因为什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第①段“The number 143 has a special meaning to Kevin. It is another way to say 'I love you.'”可知，这个数字对他有特殊的意义。故选 D。

questions.prompt: 14. What did Kevin do first in the plan?
options: He visited sick kids in Children's Hospital.
He cleaned up an open space in the city.
He handed out free food to people.
He drove an old man home in the rain.
questions.translation: 计划中凯文首先做了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第②段“Kevin did his first good thing in the plan. He cleaned up an open space in the city.”可知，第一件事是清理城市里的一块空地。故选 B。

questions.prompt: 15. Kevin wishes us to ________ in the last paragraph.
options: pass love and kindness together with him
find meaningful numbers in life like him
make a plan like him before doing things
questions.translation: 在最后一段中，凯文希望我们做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第④段“I want to encourage more people to join me. I hope that there will be a ripple effect... Let's start some ripples and see how far they can go!”可知，他希望鼓励大家和他一起传递爱心与善意。故选 A。

questions.prompt: 16. Which of the following best shows the structure of the passage?
options: [HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 110 122" width="110" height="122" style="max-height:80px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;display:inline-block;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="110" height="122"/></svg>]

[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 113 121" width="113" height="121" style="max-height:80px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;display:inline-block;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="113" height="121"/></svg>]

[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 80 116" width="80" height="116" style="max-height:80px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;display:inline-block;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="80" height="116"/></svg>]

[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 85 122" width="85" height="122" style="max-height:80px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;display:inline-block;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="85" height="122"/></svg>]
questions.translation: 下列哪一项最能体现本文的篇章结构？
questions.explanation: 第①段总起介绍做143件好事的特殊意义（总）；第②③段列举具体行动（清理空地、发食物、探望患儿、帮老人）（分）；第④段总结核心主旨并号召更多人参与（总），呈现标准的“总—分—总”结构（① ➔ ②③ ➔ ④）。故选 D。

sections.title: 二、补全文章
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文，从方框内所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余选项。
sections.passage:
Last weekend, our whole family ate outside. We sat down and waited at a restaurant. After a while, the dishes started coming one by one. After finishing all the dishes, I found it hard to eat any more. [17] At that moment, I felt lighter and enjoyed the delicious cake. But wait, why do I have space (空间) for it?

To answer the question, let's think about two other ones first. What's your favourite food? And would you like to eat it every day? Imagine that you could keep eating your favourite food for two days. Sounds good, doesn't it? Now, let's have the food for five days, and then ten days. [18] Because you eat too much of it.

Dessert (甜点) is usually the last dish during a dinner. [19] At this moment, a dessert comes in as a different kind. Your brain (大脑) makes you want to try something new. It is because of dopamine (多巴胺). When you eat dessert, your brain gives off dopamine. [20] So the dopamine "gives" new space for more dessert.

Of course, because dessert is so delicious, we must be careful not to overeat. Too much of anything can be bad for your health!
wordbank: It will make you want more sweet things.
After eating a lot, you may be less interested in the same kind of food.
Then, the ice cream cake came to the table.
You may not want to eat it anymore.
Eating a lot of dessert can make you feel happy.

questions.translation: 然后，冰淇淋蛋糕被端上了餐桌。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着说“At that moment, I felt lighter and enjoyed the delicious cake”，承接上文吃饱之后蛋糕上桌的场景。故选 C (Then, the ice cream cake came to the table.)。

questions.translation: 你可能再也不想吃它了。
questions.explanation: 前句假设连续吃了五天甚至十天最喜欢的食物，后句解释“Because you eat too much of it”，可知此处表达连续吃太多就会吃腻、不想再吃了。故选 D (You may not want to eat it anymore.)。

questions.translation: 吃了很多之后，你可能会对同类食物不太感兴趣。
questions.explanation: 后句说明“At this moment, a dessert comes in as a different kind. Your brain makes you want to try something new”，对应前句吃多同类食物产生饱腹疲劳感。故选 B (After eating a lot, you may be less interested in the same kind of food.)。

questions.translation: 它会让你想要更多甜食。
questions.explanation: 前句提到大脑释放多巴胺，后句承接“So the dopamine 'gives' new space for more dessert”，说明多巴胺会刺激让人更想吃甜的。故选 A (It will make you want more sweet things.)。

sections.title: 三、完形填空
sections.instruction: 第三节 阅读短文，理解其大意，从 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Wu Xiong, a 41-year-old man, became the headteacher of Tangfang Primary School in Baling Town, Xingren City, Guizhou Province in 2004. At that time, the school was a [21] and old house. There were just three teachers and 75 students. Many kids didn't want to go to school because they found it [22] So Wu thought of a new idea-sports. In 2006, the school [23] its first sports meeting. The students all loved it! Later, they could play more sports like basketball, football, and [24] The kids had a great time and more students [25] to go to school. In 2009, Tangfang Primary School became a boarding school (寄宿学校). Hundreds of students lived there. They had [26] time after class. Wu held more sports activities to make their lives interesting. These sports activities were very [27] with the students. Now the school has 42 teachers and 469 students. The equipment (器材) rooms are always [28] for students. They can use the sports equipment anytime they want. Wu also made a [29] that P.E. classes must be for sports.

Students do sports for at least two hours every day. Among the 469 students, only six of them wear glasses. Playing different sports can not only help the students stay healthy, but also make them live [30]

questions.translation: 那时，学校是一所又小又旧的房子。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“There were just three teachers and 75 students”可知学校规模很小、条件简陋。故选 C (small)。

questions.translation: 很多孩子不想去上学，因为他们觉得学校很无聊。
questions.explanation: 根据“Many kids didn't want to go to school because they found it...”可知孩子们觉得无趣，所以吴校长才想通过体育让学校有趣。故选 B (boring)。

questions.translation: 2006年，学校举办了第一届运动会。
questions.explanation: 举办运动会用动词 have / hold，have its first sports meeting 意为“举行第一届运动会”。故选 D (had)。

questions.translation: 后来，他们可以进行更多体育运动，比如篮球、足球和羽毛球。
questions.explanation: basketball, football 为球类体育项目，选项中只有 badminton（羽毛球）属于同类运动。故选 B (badminton)。

questions.translation: 孩子们玩得很开心，更多的学生开始去上学了。
questions.explanation: 与前面很多孩子不想去上学形成对比，有了体育活动后大家开心了，更多学生开始来上学 (started to go to school)。故选 A (started)。

questions.translation: 他们在课后有空闲时间。
questions.explanation: 寄宿学校学生课后有课余空闲时间 (free time)，吴校长组织活动充实生活。故选 C (free)。

questions.translation: 这些体育活动在学生中非常受欢迎。
questions.explanation: be popular with 为固定搭配，意为“受……欢迎”。故选 D (popular)。

questions.translation: 器材室总是对学生开放。
questions.explanation: 根据后句“They can use the sports equipment anytime they want”可知随时可用，因此器材室总是开放的 (open)。故选 A (open)。

questions.translation: 吴校长还定了一条规矩：体育课必须用于体育活动。
questions.explanation: make a rule 意为“制定规则/规矩”。故选 D (rule)。

questions.translation: 参加各种体育运动不仅能帮助学生保持健康，还能让他们生活得快乐。
questions.explanation: 体育活动既增强了体质（stay healthy），也让生活快乐幸福（live happily）。故选 B (happily)。

sections.title: 四、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 第四节 阅读短文，在空白处填一个适当的单词或用所给词的正确形式填空，使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage:
You can find something different in schools now.

In the past, students [31] (run) to the toilet and then back to class with no time for anything else. But now, things are really [32] (difference). "I can have more time to rest and share interesting things with my classmates, and it is really great," said Kevin from Kunming. "I can run to the sports field and play soccer [33] my friends," said another student.

From this term, students at primary and middle schools in Kunming have [34] (long) breaks between classes. They changed from 10 minutes to 15 minutes, encouraging more outdoor [35] (activity) among students. Students now can spend more time outside, [36] they can be healthier and happier both in body and mind. To help students better enjoy break time, some schools mixed break time with labor education (劳动教育) by [37] (open) planting areas and animal feeding areas.

"We have some ducks and rabbits in our school!" said Zhang Boren, [38] 13-year-old boy. "Some students can play with them while others exercise on the sports field. Getting closer to nature is relaxing and doing exercise helps [39] (we) keep fit." What's more, many other schools have space for reading or playing the piano.

However, as the break time is longer, it's important [40] (make) sure everyone is safe. Teachers now must keep an eye on students playing on the ground. "Sometimes, the ground can be wet in the morning, so we tell students to be careful," said one teacher.

All these make the breaks safe, colorful and interesting.

questions.translation: 过去，学生们跑到厕所然后再跑回教室，没有时间做任何其他事。
questions.explanation: 根据时间状语 In the past 可知句子为一般过去时，动词 run 的过去式为 ran。故选 'ran'。

questions.prompt: 32. (difference)
questions.translation: 但是现在，情况真的变得不同了。
questions.explanation: 系动词 are 后面需要填形容词作表语，difference 的形容词形式是 different。故选 'different'。

questions.translation: 我可以跑到运动场和我的朋友们踢足球。
questions.explanation: play soccer with my friends 意为“和朋友踢足球”，介词应用 with。故选 'with'。

questions.prompt: 34. (long)
questions.translation: 从这学期开始，昆明的中小学生课间休息时间变长了。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“They changed from 10 minutes to 15 minutes”可知时间延长了，存在与过去课间时长的比较，应用比较级 longer。故选 'longer'。

questions.prompt: 35. (activity)
questions.translation: 鼓励学生进行更多的户外活动。
questions.explanation: activity 是可数名词，前面有 more 修饰，应用复数形式 activities。故选 'activities'。

questions.translation: 现在学生可以在户外度过更多时间，因此他们在身心上都更加健康快乐。
questions.explanation: 前后分句为因果关系，“在户外度过更多时间”是因，“身心更健康快乐”是果，用连词 so 连接。故选 'so'。

questions.prompt: 37. (open)
questions.translation: 通过开辟种植区和动物饲养区，将课间与劳动教育相结合。
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后面接动名词作宾语，open 的动名词形式为 opening。故选 'opening'。

questions.translation: 张博仁，一名13岁的男孩说。
questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一名13岁的男孩”，13 (thirteen) 以辅音音素 /θ/ 开头，不定冠词应用 a。故选 'a'。

questions.translation: 亲近大自然很放松，做运动帮助我们保持健康。
questions.explanation: 动词 helps 后面接人称代词宾格作宾语，we 的宾格是 us (help us do sth)。故选 'us'。

questions.prompt: 40. (make)
questions.translation: 然而，随着课间时间延长，确保每个人的安全变得很重要。
questions.explanation: It's important to do sth 为固定句型，it 为形式主语，真正的主语是动词不定式 to make sure。故选 'to make'。

sections.title: 五、回答问题
sections.instruction: 第五节 阅读短文，然后根据内容回答问题。
sections.passage:
On March 27th, the final match of the "Cun BA" (村BA) basketball games took place in Taipan village, Guizhou. There are no superstar players, no ads (广告) and no tickets in the game. Most of the players are from the local (当地的) villages and nearby cities. "We usually play basketball after work. Basketball is a hobby for us," says Wang Shenglong, the captain (队长) of the Taipan Team. How can "Cun BA" become popular? Over 20,000 people from many other places come here to enjoy the exciting game. So it's difficult for them to get a seat. Even Yao Ming says he is not sure if he can get a seat (座位). "There are no more seats here, so I bring a chair with me. Many people even bring food with them. That's amazing!" says Su Zhi, a basketball fan from Beijing. It takes him 20 hours to drive from Beijing to Taipan. He thinks watching this game makes him excited.

During the breaks (休息) of the game, people can enjoy the local (当地的) Miao dances and the beautiful singing. The winners get local special foods like rice, duck and fish as prizes. What an interesting game it is! Sun Quan, a 15-year-old boy in Taipan Middle School, likes playing basketball very much. He practices playing basketball every school night with his classmates, because his dream is to play basketball with other players in "Cun BA" one day. Right now, he doesn't do well in it, but his father tells him "Practice makes perfect".

questions.prompt: 41. Where are most of the players of "Cun BA" from?
options: They are from the local villages and nearby cities.
They are superstar players from Beijing.
They are students from Taipan Middle School.
They are from big basketball clubs in China.
questions.translation: “村BA”的大多数参赛选手来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“Most of the players are from the local villages and nearby cities.”可知，大多数球员来自当地村寨及附近城市。故选 A。

questions.prompt: 42. How many people come to Taipan village to enjoy the exciting game?
questions.translation: 有多少人来到台盘村观看这场精彩的比赛？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“Over 20,000 people from many other places come here to enjoy the exciting game.”可知有两万多人。故选 A。

questions.prompt: 43. What are the prizes for the winners according to the passage?
options: Local special foods like rice, duck and fish.
Big trophies and large amounts of money.
Free tickets to NBA basketball games.
questions.translation: 根据短文，优胜者的奖品是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第2段“The winners get local special foods like rice, duck and fish as prizes.”可知奖品是当地特色食品如大米、鸭和鱼。故选 A。

questions.prompt: 44. What do you think of "Cun BA"?
options: I think it is pure, exciting, and meaningful because it shows people's true love for sports and brings local culture and people together.
I think it is too crowded, noisy and boring without famous superstar players.
I think it takes too much time to watch and has no value for the local people.
I think it is just a small local event that doesn't need attention.
questions.translation: 你觉得“村BA”怎么样？
questions.explanation: 结合全篇体现的淳朴热爱、特色民俗与热烈氛围，选项 A（纯粹、精彩、富有意义，展现对体育的热爱并凝聚了地方文化）为最恰当的表达。
